title: Add onboarding flow for embedding + reranker models with immutable version pins and perf-profile publishing
creator: Riley Chen
description: Goal: Build a repeatable onboarding pipeline and UI surface for embedding and reranker models that produces an immutable model version (pin) and publishes a standardized performance profile to the model catalog and Console. Motivation: customers pin to avoid silent regressions when the default model changes; embeddings and rerankers require different perf and quality signals vs. generative models (latency, memory, recall@k, MRR, vector dimensions, quantization impact). Scope: onboarding script + CI job, catalog APIs to accept pinned versions, a publish_profile endpoint, Console display for perf profiles, and a staged rollout plan (internal -> canary customers -> public). Out of scope: full automated rollback policies for A/B experiments (separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding CI job creates an immutable version tag (catalog:v{semver}+build) and returns a stable model.pin string
Perf profile JSON contains standardized fields: model_pin, dims, quantization, p95_latency_ms, p50_latency_ms, embeddings_recall@10, reranker_MRR, memory_peak_mb, tokenization_details, test_corpus_id
Console shows the published profile alongside other models and exposes a copyable model.pin for customers
API: POST /catalog/models/{model}/publish_profile accepts profile JSON and validates metrics schema; returns 200 and catalog URL
End-to-end test: A request to the hosted API with model.pin yields generation/embedding results that match the sampled evaluation set within expected thresholds
Rollback: When a published profile fails CI (regression detected), the pipeline prevents promotion to canary and generates an incident note with diffs
tasks: Implement onboarding CLI: redwood model onboard --artifact <path> --type embed|rerank --publish
Create CI job that runs eval harness (perf + quality) and emits profile JSON
Add catalog API endpoint and model.pin generation logic (immutability + semantic versioning)
Console: UI card to display profiles, historical comparisons, and copy-pin button
Automated tests: unit + integration + perf regression job on PRs
Docs: quickstart for customers and internal runbook for troubleshooting
risks: Metric mismatch: embedding recall and reranker MRR use different evaluation corpora; we must standardize or clearly label corpora
Pinned models may increase storage and memory pressure in Dedicated clusters if many low-use pins are created
False confidence: perf numbers can fluctuate with hardware (GPU model, quantization); profile must include hardware metadata
Backward compatibility: existing API users expect model names; introducing model.pin parameter may require client SDK changes
notes: Design decisions so far: 1) model.pin is an immutable token (catalog:v{major}.{minor}.{build}-{commit}) that maps to artifact S3/GCS path; 2) Profiles will include hardware tags (gpu_type, cuda, cuDNN, quant backend) so that latency numbers are meaningful; 3) We will not auto-delete pinned artifacts; billing/retention policy will be a separate PM ticket. Trade-offs: stricter validation of quality metrics slows onboarding but reduces customer regressions. We chose to prioritize safety for P0 onboarding.
